The organ that pumps blood is the heart.

Accessibility Audit:
The provided text describes a scenario where public transportation information is presented in a graphical format without accompanying text descriptions. This approach fails to meet accessibility standards for individuals using screen readers, as screen readers cannot interpret images or graphics without alternative text (alt text) or other descriptive content. To improve accessibility, the website should provide text-based alternatives for all graphical information, ensuring that users with visual impairments can access the real-time bus and train schedules. Additionally, considering the use of semantic HTML and ARIA labels could further enhance the experience for assistive technology users.
